mentions.name: Dropnote
mentions.description: A QR-code-based messaging tool for physical businesses. Visitors scan a QR code at a specific spot and leave a short message in their browser, with no app or account required. Messages are asynchronous (staff reply when available, not live chat), anonymous by default, with no customer tracking, and are tied to specific physical locations. It is designed for in-the-moment feedback or questions that do not justify interrupting staff or becoming public reviews. Free early access until September 30, 2026, with no payments yet.
mentions.problem: In-the-moment feedback or questions at physical businesses often do not justify interrupting staff or becoming public reviews, leaving no easy channel for visitors to leave a quick message.
mentions.audience: Physical business owners and staff who want to receive in-the-moment customer feedback and questions without interruptions or public reviews
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building Dropnote, a small tool for physical businesses.

Someone who is physically at a place can scan a QR code and leave a short message in their browser. No app, no account. Messages are asynchronous; staff reply when available. This is not live chat. It's meant for in-the-moment feedback or questions that don't justify interrupting staff or becoming public reviews.
